title: dpty-operate skill: update to project nvridl model + add recipe-authoring walkthrough
description:
Align dpty-operate with govnr ADR-0009 (project nvridl) and add recipe authoring.

Replace the stale boundaries (LEDGER-not-scheduler / gvnr never dispatches) with
the nvridl model: per-machine desired-state (not a fleet scheduler), capacity
reservation (auto-release reverts to desired state), phase-aware job queue
(prepare now/execute later), facts-published/agent-reasons (no auto-sizing/
auto-placement), remote loadout control allowed (authz + provenance).

Add an "Authoring a recipe" walkthrough (template -> requirements -> source ->
runtime -> lifecycle -> validate -> commit) with `dpty recipe validate` built in.
details.md: document dpty recipe validate/match + the DGX Spark unified-memory
gotcha (nvidia-smi [N/A] -> mem_gb fallback).

Source of truth: byteowlz/dpty/.agents/skills/dpty-operate/; published to
byteowlz/skillissues (canonical skills repo).
